This course is split into 2 main parts: the course materials, and the optional/additional materials.

## Course materials

The course materials are split into the below 4 parts.

### Foundations
![](/images/foundational.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: 5px white solid" fig-align="center"}

The [Foundations part](/foundations/intro.qmd) introduces the use of R with RStudio, building a strong foundation for the rest of the course.

The topics covered include:

- [**Operators**](/foundations/operators.qmd): Include `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/`, they allow us to use R like a calculator
- [**Variables**](/foundations/variables.qmd): Allow us to save the output from commands so we can use them in future commands
- [**Functions**](/foundations/functions.qmd): R contains a plethora of <u id='function_tooltip'>__functions__</u> that perform many different tasks
- [**Directories**](/foundations/directories.qmd): How to change directory/folders and view their content
- [**Script editor**](/foundations/script_editor.qmd): Use of the Rstudio script editor to write, edit, and save code in scripts

### R Objects
![](/images/RObjects.png){style="width:150px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: white 5px solid" fig-align="center"}

The [R objects part](/objects/intro.qmd) covers the two major R terminologies to learn to fully understand __R objects__.
These are:

- [__Class__](/objects/basic_classes.qmd): __R objects__ specific classes which determine what the __object__ is
- [__Data structure__](/objects/data_structure.qmd): This determines the structure of an __R object__

### Files & subsetting

The [Files & subsetting part](/files_subsetting/intro.qmd) demonstrates how to get tabular data in and out of R as well as how to manipulate it.

The part includes:

- [**Reading from a file**](/files_subsetting/reading.qmd): Reading data from a file and create and R object from it
- [**Subsetting**](/files_subsetting/subsetting.qmd): Subsetting a `data.frame` with indexxes
- [**Writing to a file**](/files_subsetting/writing.qmd): Writing data from a R object into a file

### Handy tips and tricks
![](/images/magic.png){style="width:150px; border-radius:5px; border: white solid 5px; background:white" fig-align="center"}

The [handy tips & tricks part](/tips_tricks/intro.qmd) reinforces the previous parts whilst introducing a variety of handy practices with R and RStudio.

The topics covered are:

- [**R conventions**](/tips_tricks/conventions.qmd): Covers naming styles for variables and wide vs long coding
- [**RStudio**](/tips_tricks/rstudio.qmd): Global options and the sweep buttons
- [**Tab completion**](/tips_tricks/tab_complete.qmd): Autocompletion of file paths, function names, and arguments with tab
- [**Identical**](/tips_tricks/identical.qmd): The `identical()` function to determine if 2 object are identical or not
- [**Shortcuts**](/tips_tricks/shortcuts.qmd): Various keyboard shortcuts for RStudio






## Extra materials

There are extra materials you can attempt after the workshop. 

### Plots



The [plots](/plots/plots_intro.qmd) part includes creating:

- [Line graphs](/plots/line.qmd)
- [Histograms](/plots/histogram.qmd)
- [Scatterplots](/plots/scatter.qmd)
- [Boxplots](/plots/boxplot.qmd) 

### Statistics

The [statistics](/stats/stats_overview.qmd) part will cover carrying out:

- [Linear regression](/stats/linear_regression.qmd)
- [T-test](/stats/t_test.qmd)

### Programming

Finally, the last part will introduce some harder coding where you'll learn to create:

- [Loops](programming/loop_types.qmd)
- [If statements](programming/if.qmd)
- [Custom functions](/programming/functions.qmd)
